stem: A pharmacist plans continuing education for the two-year Massachusetts renewal cycle. Which statements are generally correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Complete at least 20 contact hours in each calendar year.
Include at least two contact hours of pharmacy law each calendar year.
Use no more than 15 home-study hours in a calendar year absent an exception.
Carry unused hours freely into the next calendar year.
Do not carry unused annual hours into the next calendar year.

explanation.core_reasoning: The supported conclusions on these facts are: Complete at least 20 contact hours in each calendar year. Include at least two contact hours of pharmacy law each calendar year. Use no more than 15 home-study hours in a calendar year absent an exception. Do not carry unused annual hours into the next calendar year.

choice_analysis.A: Supported: Complete at least 20 contact hours in each calendar year.
choice_analysis.B: Supported: Include at least two contact hours of pharmacy law each calendar year.
choice_analysis.C: Supported: Use no more than 15 home-study hours in a calendar year absent an exception.
choice_analysis.D: Not supported: Carry unused hours freely into the next calendar year.
choice_analysis.E: Supported: Do not carry unused annual hours into the next calendar year.

related_facts: A renewing pharmacist generally completes 20 contact hours in each calendar year of the two-year cycle, including at least two hours of pharmacy law each year, with limits on home study and daily credit.
explanation.mpje_trap: Distinguish this near-miss from the controlling rule: 'Carry unused hours freely into the next calendar year.'
